mentions.name: Optio
mentions.description: AI agent orchestration platform built on Kubernetes. It supports three agent types: coding agents placed into cloned repos with a ticket (Jira/Linear/Notion/GitHub) that work until they open a PR, resume on CI failures or GitHub feedback, and merge; standalone parameterized agent runs with no repo checkout for tasks like generating reports, triaging alerts, auditing dependencies, querying databases, and posting to Slack; and persistent long-lived, named, message-driven agent processes with a stable slug, inbox, and cyclic state machine that wake on user messages, agent messages, webhooks, cron ticks, or ticket events.
